model.odds: 1 + initial FREE sites covered by the expansion + final-three hits on the expansion
model.placementPolicy: maximum exact conditional expected payout after first five; smallest ID wins ties

originalPaytableLayoutSearch.method: For each FREE triplet enumerate all first-five sets, evaluate each activation level, and accumulate singleton/pair/triple trigger-intersection moments. Recover all 2300 trigger triplet expectations from these moments. Minimum over all layouts bounds every draw-independent layout mixture.

necessaryAtLeastOneTierCutFor50.argument: If every payout retains fraction r or more of its original value, every policy expectation is at least r times its original value. The optimal-layout minimum therefore remains at least r times the reported global minimum. Reaching 50% requires r <= 50/globalMinimum. This is a necessary bound, not a sufficient payout adjustment.
